claims.sourceSupport: Bounded selection and planning considerations; it does not prescribe one universal strategy, approval authority, or Securium implementation-plan schema.

claims.claim: The official guidebook describes implementing selected countermeasures, reporting progress and non-implementation or delay reasons, and having management review whether implementation is accurate and effective.
